full_judgment:
Abu Sayeed Ahammed, J.: Plaintiffs obtained this Rule against the Judgment and decree dated 13.8.91 passed by the Subordinate Judge, Satkhira, in. Title Appeal No. 161 of 1987, reversing the judgment and decree dated 28.9.87 passed in Title Suit No. 389 of 1984 by the Assistant Judge decreeing the suit for declaration that the kabala dated 23.1.81 registered in the Sub-Registrar's Office at Keshobpur, District Jessore, purporting to have been executed by the original plaintiff Tajuddin khan, in favour of the defendant No. 1 Mofizul Islam, showing sale of the suit land is void, collusive and not binding upon the plaintiffs. 

 4. Said Mafizul Islam did not contest the suit nor deposed. Defendants Nos. 7-9 contested the suit by filing a joint written statements. They denied the allegations made in the plaint. Their case is that they are bonafide purchasers of .70 acres of land from the defendant No.1 and are in possession of their purchased land. Neither party filed the said original deed in question in the trial Court. However, the trial Court, on consideration of the evidence on record, decreed the suit upon a finding that the said kabala is a forged and fictitious one. 

 5. Against the judgment and decree of the trial Court, the contesting defendants Nos. 7-9 preferred the appeal. The appeal was heard by the Sub-Judge, Satkhira, who, by his impugned judgment and decree dated 13.8.91 reversed the decree of the trial court and dismissed the suit. He took the view that it was incumbent upon the plaintiff to have obtained opinion of the hand writing expert about the genuineness of the signatures of the executant of the original deed in question. Against the judgment and decree of the Appellate Court, the present Rule has been obtained. 

 9. The result, therefore, is that the Rule is made absolute and the judgments and decrees of the Courts below are set aside and the suit is sent back on remand to the trial Court to hear it afresh in the light of the observations made above by this Court, within 4 months from the date of receiving of the records by the trial Court, as the matter is pending for long time. I make no order as to costs.
